title: Bond's Escape Room
specs: Largest escape room venue on the East Coast
15 escape rooms with a wide variety of themes
Free-roam VR arenas with multiplayer experiences
Live game show with trivia and physical challenges
Minimum 3 tickets to book a private escape room; groups of 2 can book by purchasing 3 tickets or choosing smaller capacity games
No age limit; some rooms recommended for ages 14+ due to scary content; Kids Mode for ages 6–13 on select rooms
Pregnant women can play; some rooms may have light jump scares
Rooms are supervised and players can leave at any time
Private experiences for your group; minimum booking size often 3 tickets

blurb: Guests solve puzzles and secrets in themed escape rooms within one hour. The venue also offers free-roam virtual reality experiences and live game shows. Private birthday parties, corporate team building, and large group events are available with catering and dedicated hosts.
